bundle.shortDescription: A star map of the Project Daybreak universe
bundle.longDescription: A GPU-accelerated 3D star map of the Project Daybreak universe laid over the real Milky Way, with the Human and Covenant spheres, slipspace routes, the Halo Array and 320,658 catalogue stars.
